name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Casa Grande AZ

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled multi-lane truck entry at NE corner off Peters Rd: satellite z20 shows painted lane islands/medians with directional arrows where the drive meets the public road; full chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in Street View (Jan 2025).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small ~1-vehicle-footprint booth structure sits in the paved entry island on the NW gatehouse drive (z21 satellite @ 32.86343,-111.79052), positioned to control inbound truck circulation. 24/7 staffed per driver reviews.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved apron between the gate line and the building face provides interior queue room before docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach is long with a large paved apron; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Two inbound lanes read from z20 lane arrows; outbound lane count partly obscured, estimated 1.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Outbound lane count not fully resolvable from imagery; estimate 1.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane gate apron with spare paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock banks on both the west and east building faces with trailers backed in; total well over 50 (est ~90).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large drop yards (west and east) packed with parked trailers without tractors; 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock clusters on opposite (west and east) building faces suggest separate ship/receive flows; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Casa Grande industrial area bordered by active farmland to the west and open desert E/S; Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Within Casa Grande's industrial fringe near other large DCs; cellular coverage likely adequate, so false (low confidence).
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a separate smaller building at the south/SE; counted 2.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.

citations.claim: Active TSC corporate careers posting for Casa Grande Distribution Center Operations Manager, ZIP 85193 (matches DC address; retail store is 85122).
Casa Grande Chamber of Commerce member profile lists Tractor Supply Company DC #111 as an operating local facility.

verification.rationale: Live TSC careers DC postings (ZIP 85193) plus chamber DC #111 listing; no closure/WARN/construction signals. Street is W Peters Rd, not N Peters Rd in mapping sources.
